name: Suzhou Oriental Semiconductor Company Limited
summary: Suzhou Oriental Semiconductor Company Limited, a semiconductor company, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of power devices, digital power management ICs, digital real-time controllers, and automotive-grade analog front-end ICs in China and internationally. The company offers SJ and SGT metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs), insulated-gate bipolar transistors, trench MOSFETs, power modules, SiC MOSFETs, gallium nitride high electron mobility transistors, power ICs, low dropout products, operational amplifiers, and DSPs.
